added.summary: A notification is a glass plate with two corners cut, a rail and a wash in its tone, the tone's mark in an octagon socket, its title in small capitals of the tone and its body in white; each tone has its own hue. A toast is the compact plate with the tone's mark before its words. Under reduced motion they fade in place instead of sliding. New parts notifications.title, notifications.mark and notifications.toast.

HUD type over the scene with no plate: the headline large and balanced over a lit gold rule, the line under it in gold small capitals, with a near-opaque stroke so it holds over a bright sky; a phone type step; it fades in place under reduced motion. New part banner.rule.

HUD type at the foot of the screen inside the HUD's safe edges: the speaker in gold small capitals over the words in white with a near-opaque stroke, on a soft dark shade that holds them over the brightest sky. Lines wrap balanced, so no word is left alone; an older line steps back smaller.

The level up is HUD type: the word in gold small capitals, the level a large white figure lit gold inside a ring of light that settles and stays lit; it no longer draws the style's tag halo of stacked shadows. Under reduced motion the ring, word and figure appear in place.

Messages are cut cards, an unread one with a gold rail and the open one washed gold; the count sits on a dark cut tag; the open message is in a sunken reader; attachments are dark cut chips with their amount as a gold figure; Claim is the reward's gold face; an expired state reads in the danger colour, a claimed one in the success colour. On a narrow inbox the list sits over the reader in one column.

Articles are cut cards, a pinned one with a gold rail; the kind is a chip in the info hue, Pinned and Unread gold tags; the headline is a figure-sized title on a quiet toggle; the picture is cut to match.
